@@U01619@@
Name is sound and smoke clouding heaven's light.

@@U01621@@
Yes, that’s all fine and good. Our priest says the same thing, almost, except he puts it differently.

@@U01623@@
It’s what we all say, every human heart under the sun, each in his own way. So why not I in mine?

@@U01625@@
It all sounds so nice, so fine when you say it; and yet it’s still not right, something wrong. You have no Christianity.

@@U01627@@
Dear child!

@@U01629@@
It’s hurt me for a long while now, seeing you in such company.

@@U01631@@
How so?

@@U01633@@
That person, the one who's always with you— I hate him, I hate him from the depths of my soul. Nothing in my life has ever pained me so deeply as the sight of that man’s loathsome face.
translation:
@@U01619@@
名字是遮蔽天堂之光的声音和烟雾。

@@U01621@@
是的，这一切都很好。我们的牧师几乎说了同样的话，只是他的说法不同。

@@U01623@@
这就是我们大家所说的，阳光下的每一颗人心，都有自己的方式。那么为什么我不在我的里面呢？

@@U01625@@
当你说出来的时候，这一切听起来都是那么美好、那么美好；但它仍然不对，有些不对劲。你没有基督教。

@@U01627@@
亲爱的孩子！

@@U01629@@
看到你和这样的人在一起，我已经伤心了很长一段时间了。

@@U01631@@
怎么会这样呢？

@@U01633@@
那个人，那个一直陪在你身边的人——我恨他，我从灵魂深处恨他。在我的一生中，没有什么比看到那个男人令人厌恶的脸更让我痛苦的了。
